name: risys
description: RISYS — Risk Intelligence System. Automated GRC for Saudi regulatory frameworks.

scripts.build: npm run build:app && npm run build:console
scripts.build:app: vite build --mode app --outDir dist/app && node scripts/postbuild.mjs app
scripts.build:console: vite build --mode console --outDir dist/console && node scripts/postbuild.mjs console
scripts.deploy:app: npm run build:app && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.app.jsonc
scripts.deploy:console: npm run build:console && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.console.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:app && npm run deploy:console
scripts.check: npm run check:rtl && npm run test:gate
